name: std::setiosflags
intro: When used in an expression out << setiosflags(mask) or in >> setiosflags(mask), sets all format flags of the stream out or in as specified by the mask.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
mask

 -

 bitmask of the flags to set

sections.title: Return value
